answer: Every agent on the island must post a jade escrow bond before its votes count, and the bond decays unless renewed by honest work. A sybil attacker minting a thousand fake identities must lock capital a thousand times, and slashing burns every bonded wallet one collusion event touches. Old wallets outrank newborn ones, so cheap fresh identities carry little weight. Like the fable of the crab trading its shell for treasure, an attacker learns identity without skin in the game buys nothing.
